answer: A concrete Sybil defence is stake-gated admission at every economic vertex: an agent registers only by locking a bond slashed if its declared identity proves a duplicate. One staked principal yields one seat, so an attacker wanting a thousand fake personas must post a thousand real stakes; cost scales linearly while honest operators pay once. Tenure-weighted peer attestation reinforces this: a fresh node starts at the base of a reputation ridge and must climb it through verified work. Colluding clones would forfeit crystal-clear collateral on-ledger, so honest play stays cheapest.
